evidence.title: Text-Anchored Semantic Perturbations for Transferable Jailbreak Attacks on Multimodal Large Language Models

summary: A new study introduces text-anchored semantic perturbations as a method to bypass safety measures in multimodal large language models. The findings highlight vulnerabilities that could enable adversarial attacks across different AI systems.
title: Researchers Uncover Transferable Jailbreak Attacks on Multimodal AI Models
